_comment: Launchable pipeline presets. POST /run picks one by key (default: sarek). Each entry is exactly the arguments Petri appends to `nextflow`; paths are relative to the Petri directory the server runs from. Adding a pipeline = adding an entry here, no server change. The frontend Catalog view is a read-only reference of all nf-core pipelines; this file is the short list Petri can actually launch.

sarek.label: sarek · germline variants · 5 synthetic donors (test data)

viralrecon.label: viralrecon · SARS-CoV-2 amplicon · 5 real COG-UK samples
viralrecon._why_this_revision: 3.0.0 defaults --genome to MN908947.3 whose config carries an empty bowtie2_index, and its strict schema validation rejects the empty string no matter what we pass. 2.6.0 is the battle-tested COG-UK-era release and validates clean.

differentialabundance.label: differentialabundance · wt vs cox4Δ DE · consumes the rnaseq run's count matrix
differentialabundance._why: The cross-run chain: this run's --matrix IS the published output of rnaseq run 44cee82e. One withdrawal upstream must reach every DE result here — the first pipeline-boundary crossing.

rnaseq.label: rnaseq · yeast wild-type vs cox4Δ · 4 real samples (PRJNA589326)
